_note: Hand corrections to site-src/places.json (made by tools/geocode_places.py), merged by tools/build_site.py and always winning. Key: the exact PLAC text. Value: any of lat, lon, precision ('place' to put it on the map), label (the name shown), approx (true if the point is a nearby town or the centre of the commune). Example: "Musterdorf, Hessen, Germany": {"lat": 50.5, "lon": 9.1, "precision": "place", "approx": true}
